acceptance: ENABLE routing documented before firmware macro is enabled
exact board revision and schematic archived
VDD/VIN range and pull-up direction verified
ENABLE is accessible or a safe hardware-enable substitute is documented
REG and IN/TRIG behavior are verified
no hidden power source or battery is connected
materials.reason_not_automatically_accepted: the public pinout documents VIN, GND, SDA, SCL, motor outputs and INT, but does not establish an exposed DRV2605L ENABLE pin for the HERUS gate

materials.candidate: one ERM or LRA with manufacturer datasheet
acceptance: rated voltage and overdrive limits documented
manufacturer limits do not conflict with fixture envelope

materials.candidate: bench DC supply with current limit and output switch
acceptance: single-point power source with no parallel battery

materials.candidate: logic analyzer or oscilloscope with digital channels
acceptance: exportable private raw log and digest

materials.role: OUT+ / OUT- measurement for later gate
acceptance: differential measurement appropriate for PWM output
no common-ground probe across OUT+ and OUT-

materials.candidate: series supply switch or enable interlock
acceptance: cutoff result recorded in private evidence

promotion_rule: No material status may move to verified from repository metadata alone; board photo, schematic, datasheet and bench observation are required.
